description: Controller has not consulted the supervisory authority prior to processing when DPIA indicates high risk that cannot be mitigated. Article 36 requires prior consultation when DPIA shows residual high risk.
applicability: Applicable when DPIA indicates processing would result in high risk in absence of measures to mitigate the risk, and controller intends to proceed with processing.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of DPIAs with high residual risk and absence of supervisory authority consultation records.
